name: Six Senses Samui
insider_take: This clifftop sanctuary on Koh Samui's pristine northern coast delivers barefoot luxury with panoramic Gulf of Thailand views, where traditional Thai architecture meets Six Senses' renowned wellness philosophy.
whats_special: Six Senses Samui sits on a dramatic 20-acre headland overlooking Samrong Bay, featuring villas with infinity pools that seem to merge with the ocean horizon. The resort's organic spa gardens grow ingredients used in treatments, while the beachfront location offers direct access to one of Samui's most secluded stretches of white sand.
pro_tip: Book treatments at the hilltop spa pavilions during sunset for breathtaking views while you unwind. The resort's complimentary snorkeling gear lets you explore the vibrant coral reef just steps from your villa.
dont_miss: The nearby Wat Plai Laem temple with its striking 18-arm Guanyin statue, and the famous Samui night markets in Fisherman's Village just 10 minutes away, where you can sample authentic Thai street food and browse local handicrafts.
pros: Stunning clifftop location with panoramic ocean views
Award-winning Six Senses Spa with holistic wellness programs
Spacious pool villas with private infinity pools
Exceptional sustainable luxury and eco-conscious design
World-class dining with farm-to-table organic cuisine
cons: Remote hillside location requires transfers to beaches
